determinism.classification: Nominally deterministic by requested configuration (temperature=0.0 fixed for both LLM roles, tau2's own default). NOT independently verified as bit-exact reproducible: Featherless is shared-batch GPU inference infrastructure, and temperature=0.0 is not a guaranteed-bit-exact contract on such infrastructure (floating-point/batch-composition non-determinism is a known property of GPU-batched serving generally, not something we tested here). No provider-side determinism guarantee was available to us for this check.
determinism.rationale_for_single_seed: K=1 matches tau2's own CLI default (DEFAULT_NUM_TRIALS=1) and was locked before C1 was observed; with a single seed/trial by design, per-seed variation is not applicable and is not manufactured or implied.

initial_state.mechanism: tau2.domains.retail.environment.get_environment() calls RetailDB.load(RETAIL_DB_PATH) fresh for every environment construction, reloading the same static data/tau2/domains/retail/db.json file (hash recorded above). No special reset engineering is required; this is tau2's own native behavior, used unmodified, identically for every task in every condition.
initial_state.cross_condition_state_sharing: none — every task in every condition (C1/C2/C3) constructs its own fresh environment from the same static db.json; no mutated state is carried between tasks or between conditions
initial_state.target_db_state_identity: PENDING — tau2's official evaluator (tau2 evaluate-trajs) derives a target DB hash per task by replaying evaluation_criteria.actions on a fresh environment; this is computed at evaluation time, not at run time. Will be recorded here per-task once C1 is evaluated, and re-verified identical for the same task_id across C2/C3.
